title: Win a Custom Catio by Wright Angle Renovations
prize: Give your cat the outdoor retreat of their dreams! Enter to win a handcrafted, pre-designed cedar catio valued at $3,000, courtesy of the Hamilton/Burlington SPCA and Custom Catio Designs by Wright Angle Renovations. Featuring multi-level shelves, a rope bridge, climbing spaces, a hanging swing bed
eligibilityText: ELIGIBILITY: US, 18+ END DATE: September 30, 2026 LIMIT: Multiple Entry Grand Prize: One (1) pre-designed showcase model custom cedar catio valued at $3,000.
